quests.title: Reading the Sky
quests.summary: Forecaster Bethan at the Met Office in Exeter wants you to learn why the weather over these isles does what it does, then read a chart with her.

steps.text: Ask the coastguard on Dover seafront about the Shipping Forecast's sea areas.
Ask the gardener by the palms in Penzance why they grow in Cornwall.
Ask the weather watcher in Lincoln what happened on 19 July 2022.
Read a chart with Forecaster Bethan in Exeter and pass her test.

quests.reward: Three Flasks of Tea from the Met Office kitchen, standing in England, and the forecasters' daily sweepstake whenever you pass a chart.
